title: Routing Decision
description: Output of the orchestrator. Routes the request to the right specialist and assigns the owning agent. Every downstream specialist receives this alongside their specific payload.

classification.description: What type of work this request is. Drives routing.

routed_to.description: Which specialist folder receives the work.

assigned_agent.description: GAP 1 FIX: Agent is assigned here at the orchestrator level — not inside a specialist. Logic: round-robin for unassigned leads, existing owner for returning clients, Diana for escalations. Never changes after this decision unless Diana manually overrides.

client_type.description: GAP 2 FIX: Buyer vs. seller identified at routing. Tells every downstream specialist which schema fields to populate.

confidence.description: Orchestrator's confidence in the classification. If below 0.70, escalate to assigned_agent before proceeding.

scenario_type.description: GAP 3 FIX: Populated when classification=comm_request. Tells client_communication which scenario template to use.

previous_handoff_ids.description: Chain of handoff_ids for this thread. Enables full traceability.

fallback_instruction.description: Human-readable instruction if confidence < 0.70. E.g. 'Caller mentioned both buying and selling — confirm intent before routing.'
